# Third-Party Agent Skills

These skills are vendored into generated projects so agents have the same architecture,
implementation, review, and UI-quality operating guidance as the template.

| Source | Revision | License | Vendored content |

| `lencx/skills` | `b848e124111be50a795cc961558247e7751825e2` | MIT | `keel`, `coding-protocol` |

| `pbakaus/impeccable` | `cb56ed6c19a07329a9fa0cd4e657bee040156593` | Apache-2.0 | `.agent/skills/impeccable` |

License texts are preserved under `licenses/`.

The template's `AGENTS.md` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` remain authoritative.
A skill may add detail, but may not override those execution boundaries.
